## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows `<type>(<scope>): <message>` with a lowercase message, for example `fix(emails): handle empty reply_to`
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] I did not add comments, `any`, or suppressions to the source
- [ ] I did not add or loosen a dependency version, and any new dependency is pinned
- [ ] I understand the code in this PR and the problem it solves
- [ ] The description above accurately describes the change
